    AVG(c_acctbal) AS avg_bal
  FROM customer c
  WHERE SUBSTR(c_phone, 1, 2) IN ('13', '31', '23', '29', '30', '18', '17')
  AND c_acctbal > 0
  GROUP BY SUBSTR(c_phone, 1, 2)
),

  SELECT 
    c.c_custkey,

)
SELECT
